# Kuailu AI CRM | Core Advantages

| Advantage | Business Value |
| --- | --- |
| AI embedded in sales workflows | AI assistance supports prospecting, engagement, record capture and analysis instead of operating as a separate tool. |
| Reduced manual entry | Automated capture and logging help sales teams spend more time engaging customers. |
| Connected data | Supported ERP, finance and marketing connections reduce fragmented sales information. |
| End-to-end visibility | Leads, customers, opportunities, orders and reports can be managed in a connected workflow. |
| Configurable processes | Forms, stages, rules, permissions and reports can be adapted to operational needs. |
| Enterprise deployment options | Integration, security and deployment scope can be defined according to the selected edition and project plan. |
